extra_life_amounts {"1234": 3.141, "9999": 9999}
join hortbot 99 foobar 1

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!command add test (_EXTRALIFE_AMOUNT_)
send_any

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!test
send hortbot #foobar [HB] ?

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!set extralifeid 1234
send_any

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!test
send hortbot #foobar [HB] $3.14

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!set extralifeid 9999
send_any

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!test
send hortbot #foobar [HB] $9999.00

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!set extralifeid 5757
send_any

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!test
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Bad Extra Life participant ID

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!set extralifeid 500500
send_any

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!test
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Extra Life server error
